skill.summary: Generates ACAS-aligned investigation invite wording, neutral question sets, and evidence logs. USE WHEN starting a driver incident investigation/interview.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the transport-investigation-acas-aligned-pack skill.

- Generates ACAS-aligned investigation invite letters, neutral question plans, and evidence log templates for transport incidents.
- Ensures outputs are suitable for investigation (fact-finding) stages, not for disciplinary outcome drafting.
- Outputs include Word-ready invite, question sets, and Excel-ready evidence log with chain of custody fields.
- Mandates neutral language, right-to-be-accompanied wording, and clear evidence handling per ACAS guidance.
- Advises users when HR/legal review may be required and requests clarification if the process stage is unclear.
